headline.purpose: The one page heading: the name on Home, the project title on a case study, the message on the 404 page.

title.purpose: Section headings and the project name in the work list.

code.purpose: Inline code in case study prose only. Breaks anywhere to stop overflow.

motion.name: link-underline
motion.purpose: The link underline thickens from 1px to 2px and turns pink (accent) on hover and focus.

motion.name: view-transition
motion.purpose: The work cover and title move between Home and a case study. Cross-document, no JavaScript.

motion.name: scroll-reveal
motion.value: animation-timeline: view(); range entry 0% to entry 60%; fade and rise 12px
motion.purpose: Work rows and case study blocks fade in as they enter the viewport.

motion.name: hero-ambient
motion.value: clouds 9s, smoke 3s, glow 3s, bike 0.35s, wind gust 2s; all infinite
motion.purpose: The Home painting moves all the time. Hover or the first 120px of scroll raises the wind. The pause control stops it.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) sets every transition and animation to 0.01ms; the hero animations are set to none
motion.purpose: Readers who ask for less motion get a still page.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Top page padding grows from 64px to 96px. The column does not change.

components.name: Text Link

components.html: Read the Habi case study.

components.css: .ds-pause-wrap { display: flex; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 16px; background: var(--surface, #fbfbfa); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); } .ds-pause { cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 0; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; color: var(--text-muted, #63635e); } .ds-pause span { text-decoration-line: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-decoration-color: var(--text-muted, #63635e); text-underline-offset: 0.22em; transition: text-decoration-thickness 150ms ease-out, text-decoration-color 150ms ease-out; } .ds-pause:hover span, .ds-sr:focus-visible + .ds-pause span { text-decoration-thickness: 2px; text-decoration-color: var(--accent, #ff7ac6); } .ds-sr:focus-visible + .ds-pause { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #1c1c1a); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The site is one narrow column of plain text and links, read top to bottom. The owner pinned the category standard (text-first, single column, like leerob.com) as a deliberate choice. The interface recedes so the work and the writing lead. The one picture on Home is a hand-painted scene at the top. There is no card, no button and no other decoration.

Rank comes from space and weight, not from size. The type hierarchy is flat on purpose: body and section headings share one size, and the page heading is one step larger. The site is light only. Motion is small and CSS-only: the link underline thickens on hover and focus, work rows fade in on scroll, the cover and title move between Home and a case study, and the Home painting drifts and sways.
keyCharacteristics: One left-aligned column, 36rem wide, centred in the viewport.
Monochrome text: one ground, one text colour, one grey. Two brand accents from the Grape soda logo: pink and yellow.
System sans only, regular and medium weights.
Links in text colour with a thin underline.
No borders, cards, shadows, gradients or icons in the interface.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Text uses only ink and graphite on paper. Pink and yellow appear only as marks behind or under ink text, never as text. A new surface adds no tint or second grey.

rules.name: The Light Ground Rule
rules.body: The site is light only, whatever the reader's system setting. The site has no dark mode and no theme toggle.

rules.name: The Flat Ramp Rule
rules.body: Body and section headings share 16px; the page heading is 18px. Weight (500) and the space above a heading carry rank. Do not add a larger display size.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Use regular (400) and medium (500) only. Bold text in prose renders at 500.

rules.name: The Space Carries Rank Rule
rules.body: Separate sections with space, never with rules, borders or background bands.

rules.name: The Pause Rule
rules.body: Any motion that starts on its own and runs longer than 5 seconds has a visible control that stops it (WCAG 2.2.2).

dos: **Do** keep every page in the one 36rem column.
**Do** use ink for text and links, and graphite for secondary text only.
**Do** mark rank with weight 500 and space above the heading (56px between Home sections).
**Do** limit motion to the link underline, the scroll fade-in, the page view transition and the hero painting. Put all motion in CSS and remove it under reduced motion.
**Do** label any raster that shows sample data in its caption.
donts: **Don't** add a second picture to the top of Home, project cards, buttons or decoration.
**Don't** add borders, shadows, gradients or icons to the interface.
**Don't** add a third accent colour, use an accent as a text colour, or add a third weight.
**Don't** add a dark mode or a theme toggle.
